name: @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-mcp-core
description: Host-free library over pi's built-in MCP configuration: Pi-global + trusted-folder mcp.json readers, validated atomic writers, live state from `pi mcp list`, and the `mcp-client.config` service contract. Shared by the dashboard server, the mcp-client / mcp-server plugins and apple-tools. Not a plugin.
